001: Good morning, I'm calling because I have a problem with the order I placed last week.
Good morning, I apologize for the inconvenience. Could you give me your order number so I can look it up?
Sure, the number is four hundred twenty-five. I received it yesterday, but a piece is missing.
I understand, I'm very sorry it arrived incomplete. I'll check on it right away.
I appreciate that. How long might the solution take?
In about ten minutes I'll confirm the shipment of the missing piece.
002: Hi, I wanted to return an item I bought last week because the size doesn't fit me.
Hi, don't worry. Do you have the receipt or the delivery note?
Yes, here's the receipt. The shirt is a small and I need a medium.
Perfect, I'll exchange it without any problem. Would you prefer we ship it to you or will you pick it up in store?
Better to ship it to my house, if possible.
Of course, you'll have it in two or three business days.
003: Good morning, I've been trying to cancel my subscription for two days now, but the website won't let me.
Good morning, I'm sorry about the trouble. Would you allow me to access your account to see what's going on?
Yes, of course. The email is the one that appears on the contract.
I can see the problem now, there's an issue with the payment system. I'll fix it for you in a moment.
Thank you so much, because I didn't know what else to do.
Don't worry, everything is all set now. You'll receive the confirmation by email.
004: Hi, I'm calling because the internet service has been down for two days at my office.
Hi, I'm really sorry about the inconvenience. Have you tried restarting the router?
Yes, I've restarted it several times, but there's still no connection.
Understood, then I'll open a ticket with the technician. What day would work for you?
The sooner, the better, please. Tomorrow morning would be perfect.
Alright, the technician will come by tomorrow between nine and eleven.
005: Good morning, I've received an invoice with a charge I don't recognize.
Good morning, I'll review it with you. Could you tell me the amount that appears?
It's forty-nine euros, but I didn't sign up for any extra service.
You're right, I can see it's an administrative error. I'll proceed to cancel it.
Can you confirm it won't happen again?
Yes, I'll make a note on your file so it doesn't happen again.
006: Hi, I wanted to ask about the status of my claim, I filed it two weeks ago.
Hi, give me a moment and I'll look it up in the system. Could you remind me of your name?
My name is Laura, and the claim number is three hundred eighty.
I've got it, it's under review. We'll let you know in a few days.
Could you give me an approximate date?
We estimate it will be resolved before the end of the month.
007: Good morning, I need to change the delivery address for an order that hasn't shipped yet.
Good morning, of course, give me the order number and the new address.
The order is number five hundred twelve, and the address is Mayor Street, number twenty.
Perfect, I've updated the details. The order will go out tomorrow without any problem.
I'm really glad, thank you for being so quick.
Thank you, anything you need, don't hesitate to let me know.
008: Hi, I'm calling because the product I received is defective and doesn't work.
Hi, I'm so sorry. Could you describe exactly what the problem is?
The battery won't charge, even though I left it plugged in all night.
Understood, that's not normal. We'll send you a new one right away.
Do I have to return the broken one?
Yes, we'll send you a label so you can return it at no cost.
009: Good morning, I wanted to request a copy of my contract because I can't find it.
Good morning, of course. I'll send it to you by email in a few minutes.
Thank you very much, I need it for some paperwork at the bank.
Don't worry, it'll reach you today. Would you also like it sent by regular mail?
That's not necessary, email is enough.
Perfect, then it's done. Have a great day.
010: Hi, I received an email from you about a promotion, but the link doesn't work.
Hi, thanks for letting us know. I'll check if there's an issue with the link.
Yes, I'd like to take advantage of the offer before it ends.
You're right, the link had an error. I'll send it to you again, updated.
Perfect, then I'll be able to complete the purchase without any issues.
Sorry for the inconvenience, I hope you enjoy the offer.
